title: Triage deferred code findings into bounded follow-up work
steps: Review findings recorded by the implementation and review tasks.
Classify each finding as release-critical, required for the current PR, or safe to defer.
Create or update a bounded code task for each actionable deferred defect, including reproduction and validation commands.
Fix only one bounded high-confidence defect per iteration when it is safe and in scope.
Do not block independent PR review on findings classified as non-critical.
acceptance: Deferred findings have durable disposition and actionable follow-up tasks; no finding is silently ignored or incorrectly treated as a release blocker.
